notes.no_pull: deploy.sh --no-pull builds images on the server from the checked-out tag rather than pulling from a registry, which is how v0.3.0 and v0.3.1 were deployed.
notes.migration: 0025_conversation_state. Additive only — one enum, one table, two indexes. The previous release runs unchanged against the new schema, so the deploy is reversible without a down migration.
notes.feature_flag: ENABLE_CONVERSATION_WIZARD defaults on. Setting it to 0 and restarting the API reverts the bot to read-only without discarding drafts in flight. This is the fast lever; rollback.sh is the slow one.
notes.command_menu: setMyCommands is global to the bot token, not per deployment. Run it once after the deploy, not on every deploy.
notes.backups: conversation_state is covered by the existing dump; there is no table list to update.

mini_app_retirement.status: PLANNED — docs/v0.4.1-mini-app-retirement-plan.md. Mini App is still served in v0.4.0.
mini_app_retirement.blocker_1_vhost: docker/sites-available/app.paayatam.online.conf serves the Mini App static files AND /api/, /telegram/webhook/ and /health from the same server block. Removing the block would take the bot offline. Retirement means deleting only the static locations (root, /assets/, = /index.html and the SPA fallback) and keeping every proxy_pass — a surgical edit, not a service removal.
mini_app_retirement.blocker_2_deep_links: 20 templates render a «باز کردن برنامه» button built by openAppButton, plus the channel post and the invitation renderer. If the Mini App stops being served, every one of those buttons 404s. Retiring the app is therefore a code change across the template catalogue, not a config change.
recommended_order: Ship v0.4.0 with the Mini App still served, so the wizards get real use while the app is still there as a fallback
Remove or repoint the openAppButton deep links in packages/telegram
Strip the static locations from the app vhost, keeping the API and webhook locations
Deploy that as a separate release, which is then rollback-able on its own
mini_app_retirement.blocker_3_missing_bot_surfaces: Five of the 21 deep links point at screens the bot does not have: writing a review, reading revealed reviews, the coin ledger, filtered discovery, event detail. Three are small (two formatters and one wizard); filtered discovery is a product decision.

deviations_from_the_written_plan: `git pull` on the server was replaced with `git fetch --tags --prune origin`. Production runs on a detached HEAD, so there is no upstream branch to pull.

`git checkout v0.4.0` was NOT run manually before deploy.sh. The script records the currently-deployed ref as the rollback target *before* it checks out; checking out first would have made v0.4.0 its own rollback target — the exact bug that made rollback.sh a no-op during the v0.3.0 deploy. .deploy/previous-release correctly reads v0.3.1.
`ssh -A` (agent forwarding) was required. The server holds no private key — only authorized_keys — so `git fetch` from GitHub fails without a forwarded agent.
`curl /api/health` returns 404: that endpoint does not exist. The API's version endpoint is /api/v1/version, which reports v0.4.0.
